title: Blood: The Last Vampire

routes.title: 上巻
routes.notes: PS2/PSP Volume 1 (上巻). Common prologue that every playthrough must clear before Gekan (下巻) unlocks. Contains 19 of its own endings (End01-19 per both Japanese sources) reached through BSS (Blood Search System) taps and timed 2-4 choice menus. Endings 1-15 are dead-end/bad endings of varying severity; endings 16-19 are the four named 'good' endings that let the player choose Continue into Gekan, carrying over BLOOD level and a small number of story flags: End16 闇の王編 (Dark King), End17 灯子編 (Touko), End18 瑠璃亜編 (Rulia), End19 究明編 (Investigation). Only 3 flags actually carry over into Gekan and all 3 only matter on the 瑠璃亜編 (Rulia) branch: (1) 瑠璃亜の過去フラグ - asked Rulia why she became a chiropteran; (2) 吸血鬼の本フラグ - bought the vampire book at the bookstore and let Rulia keep it; (3) 五匹の子豚さんフラグ - won over the karaoke-box 'mama-san' after leaving Rulia's apartment. Gekan also has an internal 'Ooka Report' (大岡レポート) shortcut, available from a Gekan New Game, that lets the player set BLOOD level and these same 3 flags via a short standalone flowchart and jump straight into any of the 4 Gekan route openings without replaying Joukan (does not affect the in-game completion percentage, but is a legitimate way to reach every Gekan route/ending).

routes.title: 闇の王編
routes.notes: Dark King arc. Reached in Joukan via End16, continued in Gekan (下巻) via the 闇の王編 branch, which itself fans out into multiple Gekan endings (e.g. End22 「全ては闇に」, End23 「闇の王編」 per the mmitsuru numbering; xneo.jp's independent numbering places equivalent Dark King endings at its own Endings 5/7/8/12/13/19/22/23 - the two sites number Gekan's 27 endings in a different order, see disagreements). No BLOOD level requirement confirmed for the branch's main outcome; several sub-endings are gated by BLOOD level thresholds (below/above 50, 85, 100) at specific choices.

routes.title: 究明編
routes.notes: Investigation/truth-seeking arc, not tied to a specific heroine. Reached in Joukan via End19, continued in Gekan via the 究明編 branch (mmitsuru End26; several equivalent endings on xneo.jp: Endings 2/3/4/11/14/26). Multiple sub-endings gated by BLOOD level (70/80 thresholds) at the same recurring choice points (tape color picked from the desk drawer, then the escape from the underground base).

routes.title: 灯子編
routes.notes: Touko (灯子) arc. Reached in Joukan via End17, continued in Gekan via the 灯子編 branch (mmitsuru End24; xneo.jp equivalent Endings 6/9/10/24). Touko does not have a VNDB character entry, so no portrait is available.

routes.title: 瑠璃亜編
routes.notes: Rulia (瑠璃亜) arc, the route that leads to the true ending. Reached in Joukan via End18, continued in Gekan via the 瑠璃亜編 branch (mmitsuru Endings 20/25/27; xneo.jp equivalent Endings 15/16/17/18/20/25/27). This route is the only one where the 3 carried-over Joukan flags matter. Most sub-endings here are otherwise-normal bad ends; End27 (真・瑠璃亜編, see true_end) is the true-ending variant of this same branch, not a separately-chosen route. Rulia does not have a VNDB character entry, so no portrait is available.

routes.title: 真・瑠璃亜編
routes.notes: Gekan End27 per eva.hi-ho.ne.jp/mmitsuru (labelled explicitly 'End27「真・瑠璃亜編」' on that site's End27 page: geend27.htm). xneo.jp's independent numbering also lists an Ending 27 on the 瑠璃亜編 branch with an identical final choice sequence, confirming this is the same true ending under different numbering. Requirements per mmitsuru's geend27.htm: 必要フラグ (required flags) = 吸血鬼の本フラグ ON and 五匹の子豚さんフラグ ON; 不必要フラグ (must NOT be set) = 瑠璃亜の過去フラグ. In practice this means, during Joukan (or the Gekan Ooka Report shortcut): buy the vampire book and let Rulia keep it, win over the karaoke 'mama-san', and do NOT ask Rulia why she became a chiropteran (choose the 'considerate' option instead at the branch that would set that flag). The final choice chain in Gekan is otherwise identical to the other 瑠璃亜編 bad ends up to the very last exchange, where instead of 小夜「楽にしてやる」ending badly, the flags redirect to the true ending screen.

sources.title: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE上巻完全攻略 (XNEO)
sources.notes: Complete choice-by-choice walkthrough for Joukan (Volume 1): full B.S.S. (Blood Search System) trigger list with exact preceding dialogue lines, and the full choice sequence for all 19 Joukan endings. Used as a primary source for Joukan structure and exact choice/BSS text.

sources.title: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE下巻完全攻略 (XNEO)
sources.notes: Complete choice-by-choice walkthrough for Gekan (Volume 2): full B.S.S. trigger list and the full choice sequence for all 27 Gekan endings, labelled by route (闇の王編/究明編/灯子編/瑠璃亜編) where applicable, plus BLOOD level thresholds gating specific choices. Used as a primary source for Gekan structure and exact choice/BSS text.

sources.title: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE - ドラやる？ (mmitsuru), via Wayback Machine
sources.notes: Second independent complete Japanese walkthrough, hosted on a now-dead personal site and recovered via web.archive.org (live snapshots used: index.htm 2016-05-06, geflag.htm 2005-03-09, geoooka.htm 2005-03-09, per-ending pages joend01-19.htm and geend01-27.htm mostly 2009-05-20/2009-05-23). Structured as one page per ending plus dedicated pages for the B.S.S. lists, the Joukan-to-Gekan flag carry-over rules (geflag.htm), and the Gekan 'Ooka Report' shortcut flowchart (geoooka.htm). This site is what confirmed the true ending is Gekan End27 '真・瑠璃亜編', the exact 3 carry-over flags and their names, and the Ooka Report shortcut mechanic. Cross-validated against xneo.jp: both agree on 19 Joukan / 27 Gekan endings and on the 4 named route labels, though the two sites number the Gekan endings in a different order (see disagreements).

disagreements: Both primary Japanese sources (xneo.jp and eva.hi-ho.ne.jp/mmitsuru) agree on the total ending counts (19 in Joukan, 27 in Gekan), on the four named Gekan/Joukan route labels (闇の王編, 究明編, 灯子編, 瑠璃亜編), and on the true ending being a 瑠璃亜編 variant reached by maxing specific flags rather than a wholly separate route. However, the two sites assign different Ending numbers to the same content on the Gekan side: mmitsuru's numbering places the four route-representative endings at 22-26 with the true ending explicitly labelled End27 '真・瑠璃亜編', while xneo.jp's own internal numbering (also 1-27) interleaves route endings throughout the list (e.g. its Ending 15 is 'BLOODレベルを100にする' under 瑠璃亜編, and it does not explicitly print a '真・瑠璃亜編' label on its own Ending 27, though the final choice sequence for that ending is identical to mmitsuru's End27). When writing the full guide, mmitsuru's explicit '真・瑠璃亜編' labelling should be treated as authoritative for identifying the true ending, cross-checked against xneo.jp's matching choice sequence rather than its ending number. Neither source documents an official numbering used in-game (the PSP version's own END LIST menu numbers endings in yet another order per mmitsuru's index page, which lists End 01-19 for Joukan and End 01-27 for Gekan using partially-redacted titles like 'End 01「失…憶」' - these in-game numbers were not cross-referenced choice-by-choice in this research pass and should not be assumed identical to either walkthrough site's numbering when the actual guide is authored. Additionally, GameFAQs blocked fetching, so the English guide's content is unverified and should not be relied on for facts, only used if it can be read directly during guide writing.
